$comment: Reproduces scheduling-worker/ behaviour as of 2026-09-22. Not yet read by any engine.

exclusions.label: Agent shadowing
exclusions.reason: happens before the candidate comes onsite, so it is never the start of the trial. Counting it as the trial date read Sid Panjwani's 8 Sept trial as 3 Sept and posted him as an urgent unprepped trial three times.

exclusions.label: Product Demo
exclusions.reason: a screening session that sits on the Work Trial stage but happens before the trial. It carried the whole trial date on Danni El Tayeb's row and on Preston Vaughn's, whose 1-session Product Demo on 31 Aug read as the trial instead of the 10-session day on 10 Sept. Where a Product Demo is the ONLY session booked, the row now derives no trial date at all rather than asserting a date that is not the trial.

duration.$comment: fallbackMinutes 45 preserves the tracker's silent fallback. Probably accidental; the dashboard's refuse behaviour (null) is safer and is the intended end state.

approval.$comment: Taken from the SEED_USERS list in scheduling-worker/users.js, not from production. The tracker's live permissions are the Postgres users table (can_approve and active), where revocations and direct inserts are not reflected in the seed. This list has not been reconciled against production Postgres; do that before any engine reads it.
